^<font=CROOKED>^Hey, aren't you that NEW STUDENT?
^<font=CROOKED>^Here to enroll for the Student Council?

^<font=CROOKED><size=32>^Number 2. the Council keeps track of students, and eliminate them if required.

◇7sc

^<font=CROOKED>^WOULD YOU SPARE ONE OF YOUR LEGS FOR ME?

See you later then!
